A LITTLE MORE CLARITY

Before you
make magic.

What can I make with FilmWizard?+

App and product videos, challenge hooks, educational hooks, storytelling, reveals, skits, before-and-after videos, and branded carousels.

Can I edit my video inside FilmWizard?+

Yes. The built-in timeline brings your clips, audio and text together so you can shape your video in the same creative workflow.

Do I have to film myself?+

No. Reuse your AI character, product assets and working pipeline. You don’t have to get on camera or record every new idea.

Can I remix a video I already like?+

Paste a link to an Instagram reel, YouTube video or TikTok. Film Wizard extracts what made it work and creates a new, customizable video.

Is training included?+

Yes. Training is included with the membership, alongside the Film Wizard community.

Can I cancel my membership?+

Yes. The FilmWizard offer includes cancellation anytime in one click. Confirm the latest billing and credit details at checkout.
